description: Recommend the next semantic version from commit types and API surface changes, listing the evidence for the bump level chosen.

api_changes.description: Public API surface changes since the current version (optional, default [])

kind.description: removed or changed are breaking; added is a feature

name.description: Name of the API entry that changed

commits.description: Commits since the current version (may be empty)

breaking.description: True when the commit is marked breaking (optional, default false)

type.description: Conventional-commit type, e.g. feat, fix, chore

name: recommend_version_bump
